fields.summary_ko.0: NVDA achieved fiscal year January 2026 revenue of approximately $215.9B (+65.5%) and net income of approximately $120.1B, with net margin of 55.6% and free cash flow of $96.7B demonstrating strong cash generation.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK hynix (SKHY) recorded fiscal year December 2025 revenue of approximately $72.6B (+46.8%) and net income of approximately $32.1B (net margin 44.2%).
fields.summary_ko.2: NVDA faces customer concentration risk with one customer representing approximately 22% of revenue and another approximately 14%, while SKHY has strengthened its position as an essential memory chip supply partner.
